topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Well, now, ain’t that something? Old Eli found his bear from when he was a boy, at a yard sale down at Mr. Tildon’s place. It’s a right surprise, finding a piece of your past like that. I remember when I found my old flint knife, buried under the barn. Felt like the earth had spat out a bit of my youth, right there in the dirt. Eli’s bear is all worn and the fur’s thin in spots, but I bet it brought a smile to his face, just like it did to me with my knife. Some things, they stick with you, even when you think they’re long gone.
